reproduction_requirements: Record config, code hash, training and evaluation seeds, simulator versions, steps and wall time.
Use independent final evaluation seeds after configuration selection.
Report both mean and median with seed-level data.
Keep train/test and modifier/local-actor metrics separate.
Toy or smoke experiments do not complete a full task.
Never compare against guessed curve endpoints.
evaluation_protocol.performance_target: Exceed paper results under comparable budgets with uncertainty; improve efficiency or reliability if optimal return is saturated.

mappo.configuration_rule: Use paper_common plus paper_domain configuration; no modifier

ar_ppo.role: Forward auto-regressive action conditioning; no BPTA peer-gradient term
ar_ppo.configuration_rule: Same per-paper domain settings as MAPPO; no modifier
ar_ppo.notes: Projected ARMAPPO is a separate BPTA matrix ablation. AgentMixer local-observation statement does not fully specify treatment of predecessor-action communication.

mat.role: Centralized execution reference; richer evaluation information than AgentMixer

mat_dec.role: Other agents observations at execution; richer information than AgentMixer

ail.role: Full-state PPO teacher; partial-observation student; AgentMixer ablation

bppo.core: Auto-regressive action dependencies plus successor-to-predecessor peer gradients through reparameterized actions; reverse sequential PPO updates.

agentmixer.core: Policy modifier from state and local policy features; preserve modes under Individual-Global-Consistency; local actors at execution.
agentmixer.modifier: Residual agent-mixing and channel-mixing MLPs with LayerNorm
agentmixer.continuous_mode: Concatenated local means; modifier-generated Gaussian scale
